mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 1.5% signals a tightening monetary policy environment that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to raise rates, which in turn depresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.3 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressures, which triggers a preemptive monetary tightening by the Fed, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1300.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 107.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity and a contraction in real output, which signals an impending economic slowdown and reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 107.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential construction starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals a broad-based demand surge that accelerates inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST > 1300.0 and RSAFS > 490000.0, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% combined with a stable federal funds rate signals that inflation is outpacing monetary policy response, increasing real interest rate uncertainty and equity risk premiums, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250.0 and FEDFUNDS ≤ 1.7%, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 150k per month signals strong labor market demand, which drives wage inflation and forces the Fed to raise rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 148000.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real personal consumption expenditures above 495k million dollars signals strong consumer demand, which increases corporate revenues and earnings growth expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 495000.0, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
